description: This file defines an abstract class 'PiePlotAreaRenderer' which is a base for rendering pie chart plot areas in the PdfSharp.Charting library. It includes methods for formatting and drawing pie sectors, as well as abstract methods for sector calculations.

classes.name: PiePlotAreaRenderer
classes.description: An abstract base class for all pie plot area renderers, handling layout and rendering of pie sectors in charts.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Calculates the space used by the pie plot area by organizing the sectors.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Renders the pie sectors and their borders onto the graphics context.

methods.name: CalcSectors
methods.description: Abstract method to compute positions and angles for each sector in the pie chart.
